title: Change categories that fit every kind
request:
In 3.1 plan_prefix is change of value, not type isn't it?

* Validate it
* If so, we need to update change category right?

(chosen: New intent for per-kind change categories, then redo #3's gate)
problem: The result gate labels every change with categories made for data-type fields: added, removed, renamed, type changed, nullability changed. Changes of other kinds don't fit, so they get the nearest wrong label: a constant whose value changed shows as a type change, a function whose behavior changed shows as a type change, and a moved doc section shows as a rename. The reviewer at the result gate reads a wrong description of what changed, which is the one thing the gate must get right. #1's and #5's results were accepted with such labels, and #3's gate is waiting on this.
acceptance: Every change at a result gate is described by a category that says what actually changed, whatever the step's kind.
A change no category fits is shown as uncategorized, never forced into the nearest category.
#3's result gate is shown again with correct categories before it's decided.
The mislabels in #1's and #5's accepted results are corrected in the record.

nonGoals.item: Building the extractor that assigns categories automatically
nonGoals.reason: Extraction is its own build-order step; until then categories are assigned by hand and labeled inferred.

openQuestions.proposal: One shared list: added, removed, renamed, moved, type changed, nullability changed, value changed, behavior changed. Each kind declares which of them it can produce (data-shape: added, removed, renamed, type changed, nullability changed; behavior-change: behavior changed, value changed; non-semantic: moved, renamed, value changed; and so on). One list keeps words consistent across kinds; per-kind subsets stop a kind from claiming a change it can't have. The alternatives: a separate list per kind, or one flat list any kind may use.

openQuestions.text: Changes that aren't code, like moved doc sections, don't have a before and after value. How should they show?
openQuestions.proposal: Non-semantic steps get their own table: What | From | To | Why, with moved and removed as the usual categories. Before/after columns stay for code changes. The alternative is one table for every kind, with before and after holding the old and new location.

openQuestions.text: #1's and #5's results were accepted with some wrong labels. What happens to them?
openQuestions.proposal: Record a correction in the design record listing each mislabel and its right category, without re-accepting. The changes themselves were right; only their descriptions were wrong. The alternative is to re-render both gates and accept them again.
